item.title: What Edu is reading this week (March 23 - April 5, 2026)
item.description: After a refreshing week off on PTO, I’m back with a double-sized edition covering two weeks of interesting finds in the tech world. This update features a heavy focus on the emerging “NanoClaw” ecosystem, several critical supply chain security disclosures, and some fascinating hardware hacks. Cloud, Kubernetes & Infrastructure 7 Configuration Changes That Turn a Multi-Homed Host Into a Switch/Router / How to turn anything into a router - Educational deep dives into transforming standard Linux hosts and PCs into functional home routers.
